name: Fujiwara no Okikaze
bio: Poet of the Hyakunin Isshu (no. 34); Porter’s note gives the dates as: alive 911–914.

poems.title: Gone are my old familiar friends
poems.author: Fujiwara no Okikaze
poems.collection: A Hundred Verses from Old Japan (Hyakunin Isshu), poem 34
poems.text:
Gone are my old familiar friends,
The men I used to know;
Yet still on Takasago beach
The same old pine trees grow,
That I knew long ago.

poems.title: 34. 誰をかも 知る人にせむ 高砂の (Tare o kamo shiru hito ni semu Takasago no)
poems.author: Fujiwara no Okikaze
poems.collection: 小倉百人一首 (Ogura Hyakunin Isshu)
poems.note: Classical Japanese; from the 古今集
poems.text:
誰をかも 知る人にせむ 高砂の
松も昔の 友ならなくに
